> Nowic Studio is a premium software development agency headquartered in India, serving clients worldwide. We specialize in building MVPs, SaaS platforms, AI-integrated web applications, business websites, and custom digital products. Our team combines senior-level engineering expertise with AI-augmented development workflows to deliver production-ready software in weeks, not months. Founded in 2023, we have delivered 50+ projects with a 98% client satisfaction rate.

## Services — Detailed Breakdown

### 1. MVP Development
**Starting Price:** $2,499 (₹2L+)
**Timeline:** 4–6 weeks
**Ideal For:** Pre-seed/seed startups, solo founders, idea validation

Build a launch-ready minimum viable product from concept to deployment. Includes:
- Product strategy and feature prioritization
- UI/UX design (Figma → Code)
- Frontend development (React, Next.js, Vite)
- Backend API development (Django, Node.js)
- Database architecture (PostgreSQL, Supabase)
- User authentication (Clerk, Auth.js)
- Cloud deployment (Vercel, Render)
- 1 month post-launch support

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Clerk, Vercel, Render

### 2. SaaS Platform Development
**Starting Price:** $5,999 (₹5L+)
**Timeline:** 6–8 weeks
**Ideal For:** Funded startups, B2B/B2C SaaS founders, marketplace builders

Full-stack SaaS product development with enterprise-grade features:
- Multi-tenant architecture
- User registration, login, role-based access control
- Stripe/Razorpay payment integration (subscriptions, one-time payments)
- Admin dashboard with analytics
- REST/GraphQL API layer
- Background job processing
- Email notification system
- CI/CD pipeline setup

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, Docker, GitHub Actions

### 3. AI App Integration
**Starting Price:** $3,999 (₹3.5L+)
**Timeline:** 2–3 weeks
**Ideal For:** Existing SaaS products, e-commerce platforms, tech companies

Add AI-powered capabilities to new or existing applications:
- LLM integration (OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude)
- Custom AI chatbots with conversation memory
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines
- Semantic search with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector)
- Content generation and summarization
- AI agent workflows and automation
- Prompt engineering and optimization
- Fine-tuning custom models

**Technologies:** OpenAI API, Claude API, LangChain, Pinecone, pgvector, Python, FastAPI

### 4. Business Website
**Starting Price:** $1,499 (₹1.2L+)
**Timeline:** 1–2 weeks
**Ideal For:** Consultants, agencies, local businesses, professional services

Premium marketing websites designed to convert visitors into clients:
- Custom responsive design
- Up to 5–10 pages
- SEO optimization (meta tags, structured data, sitemap)
- Contact form with email integration
- Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals)
- Analytics setup (Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity)
- CMS integration (optional)

**Technologies:** React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vercel

### 5. API & Backend Development
**Starting Price:** Custom quote
**Timeline:** 2–4 weeks
**Ideal For:** Technical founders, existing products needing backend infrastructure

Scalable API and backend system development:
- REST API design and implementation
- GraphQL API development
- Database design and optimization
- Authentication and authorization systems
- Third-party API integrations
- Background processing and job queues
- Caching layers (Redis)
- API documentation

**Technologies:** Django, Django Ninja, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker

### 6. Admin Dashboard & CRM
**Starting Price:** Custom quote
**Timeline:** 2–4 weeks
**Ideal For:** Operations teams, internal tooling needs

Custom internal tools and dashboards:
- Real-time analytics dashboards
- CRM systems with lead management
- Inventory management
- User management portals
- Reporting and data visualization
- Role-based access control

**Technologies:** React, Django, PostgreSQL, Chart.js, Recharts

## Technology Stack — Full Details

### Frontend
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| React 18 | Primary UI framework |
| Next.js 14 | Server-side rendering, SEO-critical apps |
| Vite | Fast build tooling for SPAs |
| TypeScript | Type-safe development |
| Tailwind CSS | Utility-first styling |
| Framer Motion | Animations and micro-interactions |
| Zustand / Redux | State management |

### Backend
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| Python 3.12 | Primary backend language |
| Django 5.x | Full-stack web framework |
| Django Ninja | High-performance API framework |
| Node.js | JavaScript backend runtime |
| Express.js | Lightweight API framework |
| FastAPI | High-performance Python APIs |
| Celery | Background task processing |

### Databases
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| PostgreSQL | Primary relational database |
| Supabase | Backend-as-a-Service with Postgres |
| SQLite | Development and lightweight apps |
| Redis | Caching, sessions, job queues |
| MongoDB | Document-oriented storage |
| Pinecone | Vector database for AI/RAG |
| pgvector | PostgreSQL vector extension |

### AI/ML
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| OpenAI GPT-4/4o | LLM integration |
| Anthropic Claude | LLM integration |
| LangChain | LLM orchestration framework |
| Pinecone | Vector search and RAG |
| pgvector | PostgreSQL-native vector search |
| Hugging Face | Model hosting and inference |

### DevOps & Infrastructure
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| Vercel | Frontend deployment |
| Render | Backend deployment |
| Docker | Containerization |
| GitHub Actions | CI/CD pipelines |
| Cloudflare | CDN and DNS |
| AWS S3 | File storage |

### Authentication & Payments
| Technology | Use Case |
|-----------|----------|
| Clerk | User authentication |
| Auth.js | OAuth/JWT auth |
| Stripe | International payments |
| Razorpay | Indian payments |

## Development Process

### Phase 1: Discovery (1–2 days)
- Requirements gathering call
- Feature prioritization
- Technical architecture planning
- Project roadmap and timeline creation

### Phase 2: Design & Architecture (3–5 days)
- UI/UX wireframes and design system
- Database schema design
- API contract definition
- Tech stack selection

### Phase 3: Development (1–6 weeks, sprint-based)
- 1-week sprint cycles
- Weekly demo calls with stakeholders
- Continuous integration and deployment
- Code reviews and quality checks

### Phase 4: Launch & Handover (2–3 days)
- Production deployment
- Performance testing and optimization
- Documentation and knowledge transfer
- Post-launch monitoring setup

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How long does it take to build an MVP?**
A: Nowic Studio delivers most MVPs in 4 to 6 weeks depending on scope. We follow a sprint-based process with weekly demos so you can see progress throughout.

**Q: What technologies does Nowic Studio use?**
A: We primarily use React, Next.js, and Vite for frontend, Django and Node.js for backend APIs, PostgreSQL and Supabase for databases, and integrate AI features using OpenAI, Claude, and vector search tools.

**Q: How much does it cost to build a SaaS with Nowic Studio?**
A: Our SaaS MVP Development service starts from $5,999. Pricing varies based on features, integrations, and timeline. Book a free intro call to get a project-specific quote.

**Q: Does Nowic Studio work with international clients?**
A: Yes. Nowic Studio works with clients worldwide. Our team is async-friendly and provides weekly update calls, shared dashboards, and direct founder access throughout the project.

**Q: Can Nowic Studio add AI features to an existing app?**
A: Yes. We specialize in integrating AI features into existing applications — including chatbots, LLM-powered search, content generation, and automation workflows using GPT-4, Claude, and custom fine-tuned models.

**Q: Do you provide post-launch support?**
A: Yes — we offer ongoing maintenance, feature iterations, and dedicated support packages for all projects.

**Q: Do I own the source code?**
A: 100% Yes. Upon final payment, the intellectual property and full source code are transferred to you.

**Q: Do you offer payment plans?**
A: Yes, typically projects are split into milestones: 50% upfront to commence work, and 50% upon final delivery and deployment.
